title: Sneak Attack — delayed end-step sacrifice trigger only sometimes sacrifices the creature

assertion_details.A3_triggers_fired: sacrifice triggers observed on stack at end step: 2 (expect >=2)
assertion_details.A5_cleanup_leg1: stack empty in post1: True; post1 turn=11 vs leg1 end turn=10
assertion_details.A6_endstep_survives: leg2 bear 51 zone at next turn: Battlefield (expect Battlefield)
assertion_details.A7_next_endstep_sac: leg2 bear 51 zone: Graveyard (expect Graveyard); stack empty: True

verdict_note: Two-activation leg tests acceptance criteria 1-3; end-step activation leg tests criterion 4.
limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
12x Sneak Attack / 12x Grizzly Bears deck density is a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
Not tested on the original 2026-08-02 build; verdict is scoped to v0.81.2, not a fix claim.
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
setup_line: P0: 12x Sneak Attack, 12x Grizzly Bears, 36x Mountain; P1: 60x Mountain. Cast Sneak Attack, activate twice in one main phase.
contract_line: Leg 1: two activations -> both Bears sacrificed at the end step. Leg 2: activation during the end step -> no sacrifice that turn; sacrifice at the next end step.
